utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa, are you going to the repair drive? It's at the old warehouse on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that's right! I'm so glad you're interested—are you planning to come by with something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I might stop by if I can. I have a old toaster that's been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds wonderful! I have a broken toaster I've been meaning to fix. Can anyone come, even if they don't know how to repair things?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell! Everyone is welcome, even if you just want to learn or bring something to fix. I'm telling everyone I know—hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Quinn! I'll definitely bring my toaster and see if someone can help me fix it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Oren! Bring whatever you find to my place on Saturday morning. We'll sort it all out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might have a few things I could bring. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: How does 9 AM sound? That gives us time to sort before the repair starts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Hana, I checked my garage and found some old wires and a wrench for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wires? I thought we were just doing carpentry and painting — are we also doing electrical repairs?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I might have gotten mixed up. I just found these in my garage and thought they'd be useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great if you can come! Let me know if you need any more details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'll be there. Just remind me when and where, I tend to forget things lately.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, it's at 123 Main Street community center, next Saturday. I'll remind you again as it gets closer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks Ira, I'll definitely take you up on that! Let's meet at my garage Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope the repair drive can fix my washing machine too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Uli! Bring it by my garage Saturday and we'll take a look at it together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Gus. Let me know what you need and I'll dig through my garage later today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time and where should I bring my broken blender?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure on the details, but I think Gus is coordinating. Want me to ask him for you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik, do you know if the repair drive this Saturday is still set for 9 to 3 at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Actually, Eli, it's 10 AM to 3 PM, not 9. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for the clarification, Vik. I'll make a note of 10 AM. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great! What do you need me to do? I'm handy with tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh awesome! Maybe you could bring any extra tools you have, or just come by and help out. I'm sure they'll put your handiness to good use!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I'll grab my toolbox and swing by. When and where is this happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm also concerned about the order of repairs—if we start one and run out of power, the others might be left half-finished.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you think we might end up with half-fixed systems? That sounds risky.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly. We need a prioritized list to make sure the most critical systems get fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks Jules! I'll bring my tools for sure.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you Saturday at the garage.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, I'll be there. Trying to be on time for once!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, a volunteer! We'll put that hammer-holding skill to good use.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Saturday 10-4, got it. I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Awesome, I'll put you down. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got it all planned out—Saturday, 9 to 3 at the community center. We'll make good use of that time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I thought it was 10, but I'll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'm glad you're coming early. It's definitely 9, so we'll start sharp.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I'll be there after the school run. Let me know if you need any help setting up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Faye! I think we're set for 10 at the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 at the warehouse? I thought it was at the community center. Are we mixing up events?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Gus, repair drive this Saturday at the garage, 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo! I'll be there with my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you Saturday. Bring any old bikes you've got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive? I'm happy to lend a hand—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! We need folks to help collect items from neighbors and assist with basic repairs. Are you free Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning works for me. I'll be there to help collect and fix whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, you mean the repair drive for the community center? Can you tell me more about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: My washing machine is acting up, so I'm hoping they can take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was for the community center, not personal appliances. Are they fixing household items too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping spread the word—would you be interested?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a list of spare parts and tools we can use. Count me in!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo! Let's sync up after I finish the flyers so we can match your tools to the tasks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have enough volunteers to handle all the items?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure—I think we might be short on people for the number of repairs needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many items are we expecting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, heard you were involved in the repair drive too. How's it coming along?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I'm not entirely convinced it'll work—heard it might not have enough power for all the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, really? Gus seemed pretty optimistic earlier. Maybe we can look into that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Bring something to fix or just come help out!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I thought it was at the community garden. Did it move to the center?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, it's definitely at the community center this Saturday at 10 AM. See you there with your tools!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I dug through my garage and found some copper wire and a rusty wrench—hope that helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, every bit helps! I'll be hauling over some old tools from my garage too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's right, it's next Saturday! I nearly forgot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, even basic help is valuable! We'll have you paired with someone more experienced. Can we count you in for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Uh, sure, I can help out on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Rey! I'll add you to the list. We'll meet at the community center at 9 AM for assignments.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Nell, did you know the repair drive's at the old warehouse on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for letting me know! I'd heard about it but didn't catch the location.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You're welcome! I might head over later too, if you want to go together.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
